notes: Official kotlin-compiler ZIP from JetBrains' GitHub release; SHA256 published with the release. JetBrains' bin\kotlinc.bat breaks when the install path contains a space on a drive without 8.3 short names, so OpenMind puts small kotlinc.cmd / kotlin.cmd launchers (openmind-bin, first on PATH) that call Java directly with quoted paths. They don't handle kotlinc.bat's -J options; use JAVA_OPTS instead.

seedFiles.content:
@echo off
setlocal
rem OpenMind Studio: kotlinc without kotlinc.bat's short-path lookup, which breaks on paths with spaces.
set "KOTLIN_HOME=%~dp0.."
set "JAVA_EXE=java"
if defined JAVA_HOME set "JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
if not defined JAVA_OPTS set "JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx512M -Xms128M"
"%JAVA_EXE%" %JAVA_OPTS% "-Dkotlin.home=%KOTLIN_HOME%" -cp "%KOTLIN_HOME%\lib\kotlin-preloader.jar" org.jetbrains.kotlin.preloading.Preloader -cp "%KOTLIN_HOME%\lib\kotlin-compiler.jar" org.jetbrains.kotlin.cli.jvm.K2JVMCompiler %*
exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%

@echo off
setlocal
rem OpenMind Studio: the kotlin runner without kotlin.bat's short-path lookup.
set "KOTLIN_HOME=%~dp0.."
set "JAVA_EXE=java"
if defined JAVA_HOME set "JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
if not defined JAVA_OPTS set "JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx512M -Xms128M"
"%JAVA_EXE%" %JAVA_OPTS% "-Dkotlin.home=%KOTLIN_HOME%" -cp "%KOTLIN_HOME%\lib\kotlin-runner.jar" org.jetbrains.kotlin.runner.Main %*
exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
